reasons: Cited text satisfies every element of the preferred position: once per twelve months, 30 days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, independent auditor bound by confidentiality (22.1); Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 5% (22.2); express prohibition on direct access to Customer systems (22.2).

Section 22 is the operative audit right binding Customer, and 22.3 adds further customer-favourable protections; no walk-away triggers (unlimited/unannounced audits or remote system access) are present.
Compliant status is correctly claimed with no redline and no counterparty comment, consistent with expectations for compliant findings; deterministic check on frequency passes.
